'''Abav Ghart''' was a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who led a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang called the [[Void Demons]] from their [[Void Demon pirate base|base]] on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Isen IV]] in the [[Isen system/Legends|Isen system]].
